column3: PART I
MEDICAL DEVICES REGULATORY DIVISION
(1)  The  Medical  Devices  Regulatory  Division
established under section 30(2) shall hereinafter in this Act

column2: be referred to as the MDR Division.

column3: (2)  The  Authority  shall  appoint  the  head  of  the  MDR
Division from among persons holding a recognized degree
in Medicine, Pharmacology, Pharmacy or any other related
(a)  The  principal  function  of  the  MDR  Division
shall be to co-ordinate and assist the Authority to regulate

column2: and control all aspects pertaining to medical devices.

column3: (b)  The  other  functions  of  the  MDR  Division  shall  be
co-ordination  of  applications  submitted  for
registration of medical devices and renewal of such
registration;
co-ordination of matters pertaining to cancellation
or suspension of registration of medical devices;
co-ordination of matters pertaining to registration
of importers and distributers of medical devices;
co-ordination of the issuance of licences under this
section;  and
provisions  of  administrative  assistance  to  the
Medical Devices Evaluation Committee appointed
under section  68  of this Act.
